proposals.name: Tax Rate Limitation Increase Proposition for Purchase of a Brush Truck
proposals.description: Shall the limitation of the amount of taxes which may be assessed against all Ad valorem property in Doyle Township of Schoolcraft County, Michigan be increased by up to 1 Mill (1.000) for a period of 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, and 2030 inclusive to pay for the purchase of a Brush Truck and equipment for the new Truck. One Mill represents $1.00 in taxes on each $1000.00 Dollars of taxable value. It is estimated that this proposal will generate revenue of approximately $59,701.00 during the first…
proposals.ballotLanguage: Shall the limitation of the amount of taxes which may be assessed against all Ad valorem property in Doyle Township of Schoolcraft County, Michigan be increased by up to 1 Mill (1.000) for a period of 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, and 2030 inclusive to pay for the purchase of a Brush Truck and equipment for the new Truck. One Mill represents $1.00 in taxes on each $1000.00 Dollars of taxable value. It is estimated that this proposal will generate revenue of approximately $59,701.00 during the first calendar year of the proposition.
proposals.officialTitle: Tax Rate Limitation Increase Proposition for Purchase of a Brush Truck
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote approves a new levy of 1 mill — this is a tax increase.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote rejects the new tax; your property tax rate stays where it is.
proposals.conservativeView: This is new taxation. Ask whether the need could be met within existing budgets, whether the millage sunsets, and who oversees how the money is spent.
proposals.progressiveView: New funding dedicated to a specific local service that supporters say current revenue cannot cover.

proposals.name: Road Millage Proposal for Local Roads and Street Repair Rehabilitation
proposals.description: Shall Germfask Township impose an increase of two (2.000) mills per one thousand ($2.00 per $1,000 of Taxable value on real property taxes) in the tax limitations imposed under article IX, Sec. 6 of Michigan Constitution and levy it for five (5) years beginning with the tax statement due February 2027, and continuing for tax periods of 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029 and 2030 inclusive, for the sole purpose of funding the rehabilitation, restoration, and graveling surfaced roads within the Township of…
proposals.ballotLanguage:
Shall Germfask Township impose an increase of two (2.000) mills per one thousand ($2.00 per $1,000 of Taxable value on real property taxes) in the tax limitations imposed under article IX, Sec. 6 of Michigan Constitution and levy it for five (5) years beginning with the tax statement due February 2027, and continuing for tax periods of 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029 and 2030 inclusive, for the sole purpose of funding the rehabilitation, restoration, and graveling surfaced roads within the Township of Germfask which would result at the proposed 2 mills increase raising an estimated Forty-One Thousand ($41,000.00) Dollars in the first year the millage is levied.
If approved and levied in full, this millage will raise an estimated Forty-One Thousand ($41,000.00) Dollars in 2027 to be disbursed only to the Germfask Township Road Fund.
proposals.officialTitle: Road Millage Proposal for Local Roads and Street Repair Rehabilitation
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote raises the levy back to the originally authorized 2 mills, overriding the Headlee Amendment rollback — this is a tax increase over the current rate.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote keeps the current, rolled-back rate in place.
proposals.conservativeView: The Headlee Amendment is a constitutional taxpayer protection that limits how fast property-tax revenue can grow. Overriding it raises taxes above what the constitution would otherwise allow.
proposals.progressiveView: Restores funding that inflation and Headlee rollbacks have eroded so existing services can continue.
